game-master.observedBeforeActionResult: A character carries the line around a tree; rope extends down to jeep; vehicle hangs and is winched up. The visible line/obstacle relationship fits the taut-rope fallback teaching example.
game-master.claimLimits: The invisible taut fallback comes from Jaroslav Sinecky's original interview. Do not label an editorial drawn line as an actual engine debug display or claim the whole visible rope is rigid. Do not imply the implementation is unchanged in The Last of Us Part II.
